facts.text: I am trying to analyze website traffic data for our new product launch.
I am having trouble setting up a dashboard in Google Analytics to track conversions.
I have been taking online courses through Coursera to improve my data analysis skills.
My Coursera courses focus specifically on Google Analytics and Excel.
I want to track form submissions as a goal in Google Analytics.
I have used Google Tag Manager before for other tracking purposes.
I plan to use Option 1 using Google Tag Manager.
I plan to set up a new tag in GTM for the form submission event.
I plan to create a trigger in GTM that fires when the form is submitted.
I plan to link the GTM tag to the trigger and publish the GTM container.
I am wondering whether I need to add additional settings in Google Analytics to track the event.
I want to test the GTM setup to ensure the event is being sent to Google Analytics correctly.
I want to test the setup without actually submitting the form on my live website.
I plan to use Method 1: Google Tag Manager Debug Mode to test the setup.
I plan to enable Debug Mode, fill out the form, and submit it to see if the tag fires correctly.

events.text: Plan to test GTM setup using Google Tag Manager Debug Mode
